Name: Unofficial DCBurger Portraits Content Patcher Patch
Author: Onmyoujin
Description:
[code][size=5]Description[/size]
This is an unofficial Content Patcher version of DCBurger's standard resolution portraits.  I converted it for my own use and thought I should share my work pending an official release from DCBurger himself.  The original mod can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/888]here[/url].

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[/code]
